content.json:
# Claims intake: latency, tokens, cost and failures
Success metrics M5 (time to the review queue) and the cost per claim, from the pipeline's and the API's OpenTelemetry data. Nothing here holds claim text or personal data: spans and metrics carry claim ids, stages, counts and durations only. The queries were written against the telemetry names in the code and have not been run against real Azure data.

parameters.name: InputPricePerMillion
parameters.label: Input price, GBP per 1M tokens
parameters.description: An assumption: set it to the price of the deployed model.

parameters.name: OutputPricePerMillion
parameters.label: Output price, GBP per 1M tokens
parameters.description: An assumption: set it to the price of the deployed model.

content.json:
## Latency
Seconds from a document arriving to its claim waiting for a handler. Target: p95 under 90 s (M5). Taken from the `claims.intake` consumer span's `claims.time_to_review_queue_s` tag, because a histogram's percentiles cannot be recomputed from its summary in Application Insights.

content.query:
requests
| where name == "claims.intake"
| extend seconds = todouble(customDimensions["claims.time_to_review_queue_s"])
| where isnotnull(seconds)
| summarize p50 = percentile(seconds, 50), p95 = percentile(seconds, 95), p99 = percentile(seconds, 99), claims = count() by bin(timestamp, 1h)
| order by timestamp asc

dependencies
| where name startswith "intake."
| summarize p50 = percentile(duration, 50), p95 = percentile(duration, 95), calls = count() by stage = name
| order by p95 desc

content.json:
## Model tokens and cost
The chat client emits the `gen_ai.client.token.usage` histogram on the pipeline's meter. Cost is tokens times the prices above, so it is an estimate for the deployed model, not an invoice.

content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == "gen_ai.client.token.usage"
| extend tokenType = tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.token.type"])
| summarize tokens = sum(valueSum) by tokenType, bin(timestamp, 1d)
| order by timestamp asc

content.json:
## Route and review
How claims were routed by the assessor, and what is waiting too long.

content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == "claims.route"
| extend route = tostring(customDimensions["route"])
| summarize claims = sum(value) by route, bin(timestamp, 1d)
| order by timestamp asc

customMetrics
| where name == "claims.approved_stuck"
| summarize stuck = max(value) by bin(timestamp, 15m)
| order by timestamp asc

content.json:
## Failures
Failed blob-triggered invocations, messages dead-lettered by the consumer, and legacy write outcomes.

content.query:
requests
| where name == "ClaimDocumentReceived"
| summarize total = count(), failed = countif(success == false) by bin(timestamp, 1h)
| extend failureRatePercent = iff(total > 0, failed * 100.0 / total, real(null))
| project timestamp, failureRatePercent, failed, total
| order by timestamp asc

customMetrics
| where name in ("claims.legacy_submissions", "claims.intake.dead_lettered")
| extend outcome = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions["outcome"]), tostring(customDimensions["reason"]))
| summarize count_ = sum(value) by name, outcome, bin(timestamp, 1d)
| order by timestamp asc
